chunks: Abi (radhi Allahu 'anhu) from Sa'd ibn Abdullah from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id from Fadalah from al-'Ala' ibn Razin from Zayd al-Shahham who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'The closest a servant is to his Lord is when he is in prostration.'
ai.seo_question: What is the closest state of a servant to God according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) identifies prostration (sujood) as the peak moment of a servant's proximity to God, a concept deeply rooted in Shia devotional practice where prolonged sujood is believed to facilitate deeper spiritual connection and divine acceptance. This narration underscores the metaphysical reality that the physical lowering of the body mirrors the soul's humility, making it a critical locus for supplication and divine grace.
